value.name: records attending details
value.description: Asha writes the direct line and the attending's name onto the pad while speaking quietly to the clerk.
evidence: the attending's name onto the pad in the same cramped print
asked the clerk, in the same low pitch, for the room number

value.name: obtains room number
value.description: The clerk reads off the room number, and Asha writes it down on the pad.
evidence: The clerk read it off and she set it down, four digits at the bottom of the column

value.name: ends call politely
value.description: Asha ends the phone call with a quiet thank you that barely lands before she lowers the phone.
evidence: ended the call with a quiet thank you that did not quite land before she lowered the phone

value.name: moves pad away from Claire
value.description: Asha slides the pad farther under her arm, keeping it away from Claire's side of the table.
evidence: She slid the pad an inch further under her arm, away from Claire's side of the table

value.name: warns kids are coming
value.description: Asha quietly tells Claire that the kids are coming.
evidence: said, almost without sound, that the kids were coming

value.name: Claire braces silently
value.description: Claire does not look toward the stairs and instead places her hands flat on the table as if awaiting instructions.
evidence: Claire did not look up at the stairs; she only unfolded her hands from her lap and laid them flat on the wood, as though waiting to be told what to do with them

value.name: hears movement upstairs
value.description: A second floorboard shifts closer to the landing, signaling someone approaching from upstairs.
evidence: Upstairs a second floorboard shifted, closer to the landing this time

value.name: covers room number
value.description: Asha places her palm over the page where the room number is written, hiding it as the upstairs movement continues.
evidence: Asha put her palm over the page where the room number was written
